The weapon features a metallic receiver with visible machining marks, a long vertical magazine inserted into the pistol grip, a tubular stock extending to the left, and a coiled wire attached to the rear right side. There is a distinct emblem on the upper receiver.

A coiled wire/spring structure hangs loosely on the right. Its connection point to the receiver is unclear and physically nonsensical for a standard firearm. It appears to float or merge awkwardly with the background/receiver edge.
The vertical ribs on the magazine are inconsistent in spacing and depth, with some areas appearing to warp or blend into the base material rather than maintaining rigid geometric parallelism.
The trigger guard loop seems to deform slightly where it meets the receiver, lacking a clean mechanical joint. The geometry feels soft rather than machined.
